pages.text: Synthetic biology writes genomes from scratch: the $(item)Minimal Synthetic Cell$(), $(item)Stem Cell Cultures$(), and $(item)Xenobots$() - living machines of cells. $(item)Neural Organoids$() are brains grown in a dish; Boltzmann Brains and superintelligence cores now need them.

$(item)Turing Morphogens$() paint stripes and spots by reaction and diffusion - one fast chemical, one slow. Xenobiology takes samples from the Bulk and the Foam: $(fluid)Xenoplasm$() and $(item)Silicon Life Spores$().
